rules.label: Qualified Charity Care Program base eligibility
rules.quote: Patients residing in the BCH service area, receiving medically necessary nonemergent/scheduled hospital services are eligible to apply for the Qualified Charity Care Program.

rules.label: WeCare base eligibility
rules.quote: Applicants who are over the income threshold for the Qualified Charity care Program whose adjusted household income is between 250% and 350% of the FPL.

payment_plan.quote: Payment plans that are established to pay the bills may not exceed four (4) percent of the patient's monthly household income.

notes: AGB rate is used for certain emergency services outside service area or state under WeCare.
Multiple discounts are not allowed: a financial assistance discount cannot be combined with any other discount offered by the hospital.
Self-pay discount: 50% for facility charges, 20% for physician clinic charges for uninsured patients qualifying for financial assistance.
Excluded services vary by program and include cosmetic, experimental, elective non-medically necessary, etc.
For WeCare, applicants over income threshold for QCCP (i.e., >250% FPL) and between 250%-350% FPL are eligible.
For WeCare, applicants receiving emergency services and residing outside US or outside Colorado may be eligible for AGB rate discount.
For WeCare, applicants residing outside BCH service area may be eligible if referred by BCH-owned physician practice or if service provided by BCH facility within their zip code.
Hospital Discounted Care requires screening for Medicaid, CHP+, Medicare, Emergency Medicaid, and Hospital Discounted Care for all uninsured patients.
Patients with health insurance may be eligible for financial assistance if they follow guidelines of each health plan.
Insured patients are expected to pay deductibles, estimated coinsurance, and/or copays the day services are rendered.
Applicants in custody of a law enforcement agency are ineligible for QCCP, WeCare, and presumptive assistance.
College students from outside Colorado or US in Colorado for higher education are ineligible for QCCP.
Visitors from other states or countries are ineligible for QCCP.
Applicants with FPL over 250% are ineligible for QCCP.
Applicants with FPL over 350% are ineligible for WeCare.
Applicants that received scheduled/elective services and reside outside Colorado or US are ineligible for WeCare.
Applicants that qualify for Health First Colorado or CHP+ are ineligible for WeCare.
Proof of income, address, and liquid assets required for QCCP and WeCare; homeless exempt from income documentation.
Patients who do not submit required documentation within 45 days (QCCP, HDC) or 30 days (WeCare) may need to submit updated documentation.
Once 36 payments have been made under QCCP, WeCare, or HDC payment plans, remainder of bill is forgiven and collection ceases.
For bills from health care professionals, payment plan limit is two (2) percent of monthly household income (QCCP, WeCare, HDC).

WeCare payment arrangement: interest free, tiers based on balance: $50-$499.99 up to 6 months, $500-$999.99 up to 12 months, $1,000-$2,499.99 up to 18 months, $2,500-$4,999.99 up to 24 months (auto), $5,000+ up to 36 months (auto).
BCH may limit Medicaid enrollment for certain services.
Deductibles and co-pays required for Medicaid per law.
Health Share plans: if not in-network with BCH, patient considered uninsured and must bill health share first.

BCH Physician Clinic charges: 20% discount for uninsured patients qualifying for financial assistance (not for vaccines, drugs, implants, DME, remote device checks, or services with different self-pay structure).
BCH Facility Charges: auto 50% self-pay rate for uninsured, reversed if financial assistance qualifies or insurance is billed.
Patients must cooperate with BCH to provide information/documentation for eligibility and to apply for assistance.
Patients must cooperate to establish reasonable payment plan and make good faith efforts to honor it.
Patients must promptly notify BCH of any change in financial situation.
BCH notifies eligibility determination within 14 days after request and documentation.
BCH provides refund if payments exceed approved financial assistance rate and established copayment.
BCH provides options for payment arrangements.
BCH honors right to ask questions and seek reconsideration.
BCH annually reviews and incorporates federal poverty guidelines.
AGB percentage separately calculated and updated annually for covered facilities and providers, available in Addendum A.
BCH makes eligibility determinations and application process equitable, consistent, and timely.
qccp_base may leave out a condition: Missing requirement: applicants must not be ineligible (e.g., not in law enforcement custody, not out-of-state college students)
wecare_base may leave out a condition: Missing exclusions: e.g., applicants qualifying for Health First Colorado/CHP+, or those with scheduled/elective services outside CO/US
